Netflix just and I mean JUST dropped some wild, shocking, and seriously underrated movies… and most people have no idea they’re even there. In this video, I’m reviewing a list of shocking movies on Netflix. Movies like The Lazarus Project, a highly underrated mind bender starring Paul Walker and 2025's Bugonia coming to Netflix soon.

If you’re tired of scrolling Netflix and seeing the same recycled recommendations, this list is designed to help you find something different… something bold… something seriously worth watching... and Thrash... I also talk about the shark attack movie Thrash which might be the dumbest Netflix movie I've ever seen.
